header: Name and value, in a description list
lead: Pairs in two to four columns, with an optional caveat under any of them. It is a real description list, so the pairs survive a copy and paste into a document.
note: Where the answer is only yes or no, the included checklist reads faster than a column of the same word repeated.

rows.title: Columns
rows.text: Narrower viewports drop to two and then to one.

rows.title: Numerals
rows.text: Values line up on the decimal, which is the point of a spec sheet.
